execution.controller: fixed sequence high plus feedback/gap/retention fine reclaim
execution.donors: same complete proposal set in calibration and formal; no post-calibration donor filtering

execution.reclaim: finish before curve-derived growth; whole-gap measured duration; immutable per-peak cutoff and live feedback

timing.cutoff: can move earlier only within the same protected growth period
timing.duration: slowest credited calibration batch and full request span, with feedback/batch gaps

total_faults.phase_metrics: diagnostic only; never used to veto acceptance
total_faults.zero_baseline: positive increment remains unresolved without an agreed absolute allowance

qualification.scope: entire same-service multi-app proposal, not independent donor certificates
